snippet.title: The Last Caretaker - Accolades Trailer
snippet.description:
In the Last Caretaker, you’re the last hope to save humanity. The sole surviving robot on a desolate, flooded world, you must rebuild decayed machines, nurture human seeds and begin the rebirth of humanity by launching them into space.

The Last Caretaker is available now in Early Access on Steam and Epic Games Store! 

Buy The Last Caretaker now on:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1783560/The_Last_Caretaker/ 
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/the-last-caretaker-51dfcc

Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/channel37

For more news and updates, subscribe to our YouTube and Twitch channels for weekly developer livestreams, and follow us on X, Bluesky, and Instagram.
